name: std::chrono::operator<<(std::chrono::zoned_time)

declarations.code:
template <class CharT, class Traits, class Duration, class TimeZonePtr>

std::basic_ostream<CharT, Traits> &

operator<<(std::basic_ostream<CharT, Traits> &os,

    const std::chrono::zoned_time<Duration, TimeZonePtr> &tp);

intro: Outputs tp to the stream os, as if by std::format(os.getloc(), fmt, tp), where fmt is "{:L%F %T %Z}" if CharT is char, or L"{:L%F %T %Z}" if CharT is wchar_t.
